en: The career of a young footballer can be full of highs and lows and sadly for <FullPlayerName> his took a turn for the worse as he was put up for sale by <TeamName>. At the tender age of <PlayerAge>, the player has plenty of time to come back in his career, but for now the <PreferredPos1> is probably wondering what the future holds as his club tell him that he is surplus to requirements.

It's decision time for <ManagerName1> as the role of <TeamName2> manager lands on his desk. Speculation has been rife in recent weeks regarding <ManagerName1>'s future at <TeamName1>. This latest development can only test the <TeamName1> manager's resolve and will be interesting to see which way he goes during the next few days. The <TeamName1> fans will hope he stays loyal to the club.

"<PlayerAge2> year old <PlayerName2> has been chosen by <ManagerName> for the latest international squad. With prospects high both the manager and the player are confident good things will happen. ""I chose to get the lad in the team as he has a lot to offer. He deserves his spot and I hope he relishes the chance to represent his country"" added <ManagerName> after the press conference."

"\n\n<TeamName> are still on a high after successfully winning their first match with <UserName> in charge. ""What a great result that was for us. I'm very proud of the team and I know they will continue to deliver"" stated the manager. With various players standing out during the performance it's evident that his presence on the team has made a more than positive impact on the players."

"\n\n<TeamName>'s fans have been pretty quiet in recent weeks after seeing their team play to a somewhat mediocre standard. ""I can see why the fans haven't been their usual selves. It's been an up and down experience from their point of view. We need to start performing more consistently to ensure that the fans get what they paid for. As without them, we're nothing"" stated <UserName>."

Young talented <FullPlayerName> has been surprising transfer listed by <TeamName>. The highly rated <PreferredPos1> is said to have a bright future in the game, but his current club have headed off speculation by deciding that it won't be with them. They may be looking to cash in on their asset and use the money to fund some wider team rebuilding to strengthen multiple areas of the team.

"\n\nA deserved victory today for a strong <TeamName1> under the command of new boss, <UserName>, in only his third game in charge. ""All the credit should go to the eleven on that pitch. They worked their socks off for that and thoroughly deserved the victory"" said an impassioned <UserName>. ""If they carry on playing like that week in, week out it'll make my job a whole lot easier."""

"In a game that will probably be remembered more for the red cards than the quality of the football, <TeamName3> beat <TeamName4> by a score of %1s-%2s. <ManagerName> was in agreement with the decisions. ""I don't think it was really that type of game"" he said. ""<FullPlayerName> probably deserved his red card, and looking again at <FullPlayerName2>'s, I think the same."" he continued."

\n\nA number of other international teams will also be on the hunt for a new manager after recently parting company with their respective managers. One of these is <TeamName2>, who are emerging as one of a number of potential destinations for <ManagerName1>. They have already made themselves known to be big admirers of the <TeamName1> boss and a move from the <TeamName2> FA looks likely.

\n\nPeople outside the club are puzzled by the manager's recent transfer dealings which, considering <PlayerName1>'s good form, have now given him major selection headaches over who to play at the position of <PreferredPos2>. Only time will tell if the manager has made the right decision but the addition of <PlayerName2> to the squad sees <PlayerName1> looking anxiously over his shoulder.

I'm just taking this journey one step at a time said <FullPlayerName> when asked if cup glory might mean he postpones his retirement decision to next season. The <TeamName> <PreferredPos1> might be getting on now at <PlayerAge> years, but he is still competitive at this level and so there are suggestions that if the season were to end in glory the player may just play on into next season.

"\n\n<TeamName1> 's season started with a stutter today after they drew against <TeamName2> in the <CompetitionName> in <UserName>'s first competitive match. The positives outweighed the negatives so I can't be unhappy with that."""

Here you can join in to game matches as a member of a team. Captains can select teams and change line-ups while other players can chose their positions in the game.

Speculation surrounding the future of <FullPlayerName> refuses to go away following reports that the <TeamName> <PreferredPos1> is homesick and may seek a move.\nWhile nobody connected with the club has made any official comment, it is understood that <PlayerName> is finding his surroundings difficult to adjust to and is considering all options, including a move back home to <Nationality>.

""But I have got used to the conditions now and I am happy to stay and do my best for the fans and for <TeamName>."""

\n\nNew manager <UserName> watched his team grind out a draw but it could have so easily gone either way. That game showcased the best and worst of a team which is going through a transitional period at the moment and, given time, could be moulded into a tight efficient unit. It's still early days in the tenure of <UserName>, but <TeamName1> look like they're moving in the right direction.

Speculation surrounding the future of <FullPlayerName1> has begun to run rampant after the purchase of <FullPlayerName2> from <TeamName2>. With a signing as strong as <PlayerName2> it looks as though this could spell the end of the road for <FullPlayerName1>'s starting spot at <TeamName1> as many feel that it is unlikely that either player will be content to share a spot on the team sheet.

I know it's not good to have to read the speculation in the press, but I felt nobody was listening to me at <TeamName>. I feel I'm a much better player with the sun on my back and I hope you'll agree it's for the best. I definitely want to leave and I won't be changing my mind.

"\n\nThis will be a special day for talented <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName1> as his new team square off against his old team. <PlayerName1> is hoping for a positive result and he had this to say about the upcoming game ""It'll be great to see all the lads again.
